title: SLspatial
text: SLspatial provides spatial boundary datasets Sri Lanka simple features (sf) objects. package supports mapping, spatial analysis, integration administrative electoral geographic data. includes country boundary, administrative districts, electoral districts, electoral polling divisions, administrative divisions. datasets support analysis multiple geographic levels distinguishing administrative electoral geography.

title: SLspatial
text: Install development version GitHub:

title: SLspatial
text: five datasets sf objects geometry column. Counts reflect source boundary versions used package interpreted statement current official administrative boundaries.

title: SLspatial
text: single-feature country boundary, country name ISO two- three-letter codes. geometry MULTIPOLYGON WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

title: SLspatial
text: 25 administrative district polygons. SourceID SourceName preserve identifiers names source; District uses election-aligned labels selected districts (Digamadulla Ampara). geometry remains administrative: Kilinochchi Jaffna, three administrative districts associated Vanni, remain separate features.

title: SLspatial
text: 22 electoral district polygons, derived SLAdministrativeDistricts. Jaffna Kilinochchi combined Jaffna electoral district; Mannar, Mullaitivu, Vavuniya combined Vanni. remaining districts retain administrative boundaries. derived layer, independently sourced official electoral-boundary file.

title: SLspatial
text: 160 electorate (polling division) polygons, ElecCode, District, Electorate, OrigName. Names harmonised 2024 presidential election data possible. Three names manually assigned rather confirmed exact election-data match.

title: SLspatial
text: 323 administrative division polygons, DistCode, District, EDistrict, DivCode, Division. District refers administrative district; EDistrict corresponding electoral district label, allowing aggregation grouping either geography. Administrative districts electoral districts interchangeable. Use SLElectoralDistricts electoral district geometry SLAdministrativeDistricts administrative district geometry. particular, avoid interpreting election-aligned District labels SLAdministrativeDistricts meaning polygons merged.

title: SLspatial
text: Electoral polling division boundaries: nuuuwan/sl-topojson, using polling division TopoJSON dated 20 November 2020. Country administrative district boundaries: Source administrative shapefiles used prepare SLBoundary SLAdministrativeDistricts; check associated source metadata version licence. Electoral district boundaries: Derived SLAdministrativeDistricts merging administrative polygons 22 electoral districts. Administrative division boundaries: GADM, source LKA_adm2.shp shapefile. Electorate naming reference: 2024 presidential election dataset SLPresElection. Spatial boundaries administrative arrangements can change time. included geometries assumed reproduce historical electoral administrative boundaries every election year. Users verify source licensing, attribution requirements, suitability intended use.

title: SLspatial
text: dataset descriptions, use ?SLBoundary, ?SLAdministrativeDistricts, ?SLElectoralDistricts, ?SLElectorate, ?SLAdminDivisions loading package. Issues suggestions can submitted GitHub issue tracker.

Sri Lanka Administrative District Boundaries — SLAdministrativeDistricts

title: Sri Lanka Administrative District Boundaries — SLAdministrativeDistricts
text: layer contains 25 administrative districts. Original identifiers names retained SourceID SourceName. District, Ampara labelled Digamadulla, Kandy labelled Mahanuwara, Moneragala labelled Monaragala, Nuwara Eliya labelled Nuwara-Eliya. label changes; administrative geometries unchanged. Administrative districts differ electoral districts. Jaffna Kilinochchi separate administrative districts. Mannar, Mullaitivu, Vavuniya also retained separately. layer represents boundaries supplied source dataset. automatically interpreted boundary configuration applicable every historical election.

title: Sri Lanka Electoral District Boundaries — SLElectoralDistricts
text: Derived administrative boundary dataset used SLAdministrativeDistricts.

title: Sri Lanka Electoral District Boundaries — SLElectoralDistricts
text: layer derived SLAdministrativeDistricts. Jaffna Kilinochchi merged form Jaffna electoral district. Mannar, Mullaitivu, Vavuniya merged form Vanni electoral district. remaining districts retain administrative boundaries. Internal boundaries merged administrative districts removed. resulting features ordered match electoral district order used data preparation. derived spatial layer, rather independently supplied official electoral-boundary dataset. historical applicability depends version underlying administrative boundaries. District can used join district-level election results. Select one reporting level joining avoid repeating geometries across polling-division, postal-vote, district-total records.
